quickAnswer: A beard or eyebrow transplant in Türkiye uses finer single-hair grafts placed at razor-flat exit angles, making technical precision even more unforgiving than on the scalp. Plan 4 to 5 nights in Istanbul, expect 7 to 10 days of visible redness and tiny crusts, and budget roughly €1,300–€3,250 for eyebrows or €2,600–€5,200 for beards in 2026.

How do beard and eyebrow transplants differ from scalp procedures?

Facial skin is thinner, more vascular, and constantly visible at conversational distance. Unlike scalp restoration—which relies heavily on multi-hair follicular units for bulk coverage—beard and eyebrow transplants demand single-hair grafts, finer hair-calibre matching, strict facial symmetry, and ultra-acute implantation angles so hairs lie flat against the skin rather than sticking straight out.

As explained in the [ISHRS guide to beard transplants](https://ishrs.org/beard-transplant/), follicles for a beard are harvested either from the scalp or from under the chin via FUE, where constantly changing hair directions make extraction technically demanding. For brows, the [ISHRS eyebrow restoration overview](https://ishrs.org/eyebrow-eyelash-hair-restoration-surgery/) notes that surgeons select donor hair of matching texture—usually one- to two-hair units—and carefully trace each brow's natural contour. Because transplanted scalp hairs keep growing at scalp speed, eyebrow patients must trim their brows regularly for life.
How many days of visible redness and crusting should you expect before flying?

Tiny pinhead scabs and pinkness typically remain clearly visible on the cheeks, jawline, or brow ridge for 7 to 10 days, while mild swelling peaks around days 2 to 3. Most patients are medically cleared to fly after 3 to 5 nights in Istanbul, though facial redness will still be noticeable at the airport.

According to [ISHRS beard recovery guidance](https://ishrs.org/beard-transplant/), patients should never pick scabs and must follow their surgeon's exact timeline for gentle washing and shaving. For international travellers, [NHS cosmetic surgery abroad advice](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/cosmetic-procedures/advice/cosmetic-surgery-abroad/) stresses planning rest and checking flight timing with your surgical team rather than rushing home.

body.text: Why do angle and single-hair graft selection matter so much on the face?

On the face, there is no surrounding dense hair to camouflage a misplaced follicle. If a multi-hair scalp graft is placed on the upper cheek border or brow tail—or inserted at a steep 45-degree angle—it grows as a coarse, spiky tuft that looks unnatural under daylight and is difficult to revise.

The [ISHRS](https://ishrs.org/beard-transplant/) identifies abnormal exit angles, overly straight "ruler-line" beard borders, and poor hair-calibre matching as the primary technical complications of facial hair surgery. Before committing to any provider, verify its registration on the [Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Health authorized list](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-69289/healthcare-providers-with-international-health-tourism-authorization-certificates.html) and use this facial-procedure checklist:

items: Request close-up daylight videos: Inspect cheek borders and brow arches without studio shadows (see our guide on [spotting real before-and-after results](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/hair-transplant-before-after-real)).
Ask how single-hair grafts are sorted: Confirm whether multi-hair scalp grafts are microscopically dissected into single hairs for delicate borders.
Verify who makes the recipient sites: Angle and direction are set during incision creation—confirm a licensed doctor performs this step.
Discuss permanent maintenance: Understand ongoing brow trimming and future beard-shaving schedules before surgery day.

body.text: What is the realistic 2026 cost range?

In 2026, realistic procedure pricing in Türkiye typically sits between €1,300 and €3,250 for an eyebrow transplant (usually 200 to 600 grafts) and €2,600 to €5,200 for a full or partial beard transplant (often 1,500 to 3,500+ grafts), based on published [2026 Turkish market benchmarks](https://www.metropolmed.com/blog/hair-transplant-cost-turkey/). Pricing varies with surgeon involvement, hospital setting, and graft complexity.

Quotes far below these bands frequently reflect high-volume technician-led clinics rather than physician-led facial work. Separating your hotel and airport transfers from the clinic fee—as we do through our [medical tourism logistics service](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/services/medical-tourism)—lets you compare genuine clinical fees cleanly while choosing a quiet [Istanbul recovery hotel](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/hair-transplant-recovery-hotel-istanbul).

faq.q: Can you combine a scalp transplant and a beard transplant in one trip?
faq.a: Some clinics perform combined sessions, but doing both at once draws heavily from your finite scalp donor zone. Ask your licensed physician whether staging the procedures is safer for long-term donor preservation.

faq.q: Will transplanted eyebrow hairs keep growing long?
faq.a: Yes. Because donor follicles come from the scalp, transplanted brow hairs retain scalp growth cycles and require light trimming with small scissors every week or two.

faq.q: Can I wear sunglasses or a face mask after facial hair surgery?
faq.a: Avoid resting tight mask straps or heavy sunglass frames against freshly implanted beard or eyebrow grafts. Confirm exact clearance timelines with your surgeon.

faq.q: When can I shave after a beard transplant?
faq.a: Shaving timelines vary by surgeon; many advise waiting at least 10 to 14 days for careful scissor trimming and longer before using a razor directly over recipient skin.
Yes. As noted by the [ISHRS](https://ishrs.org/beard-transplant/), once transplanted follicles heal and cycle normally, beard hairs are permanent.
